text.insert: The dispatch lease is the sole authority to dispatch worker agents and mutate a workflow's allowed checkout surfaces. HarnessState retains all workflow slots; exclusivity applies only to this fenced grant.

Exactly zero or one workflow holds the dispatch lease — the token that allows it to dispatch worker agents and mutate its allowed checkout surfaces. Background worker-result ingestion may continue regardless, because it consumes immutable evidence and never dispatches workers or touches the checkout.

props.title: Decision (2026-08-12) — HarnessState shows every workflow; "foreground" becomes active workflow + dispatch lease

text.insert: The canonical game object is HarnessState, whose cycle, run, PR, and sync slots stay present so all three workflow states exist durably at once. Only the dispatch lease is exclusive: exactly one active workflow may use it to dispatch worker agents and mutate its allowed checkout surfaces.
A DispatchLease carries kind (run, pr, or sync), workflow
handoff, and blockers. Every guarded worker-dispatch and source-mutation command presents the current lease
id; stale actors are refused. Dispatch lease, active workflow, and game.dispatch are the only accepted authority terms; obsolete foreground aliases have been removed.

props.description: Fenced authority held by at most one run, PR, or sync workflow.

fields.name: lease_id
fields.description: Fencing token minted at acquisition; every worker-dispatch and source-mutation command must present the current lease id, so stale actors from a previous activation are refused.

fields.name: requested_handoff
fields.description: Queued transition that begins after the current owner settles.

fields.name: blockers
fields.description: Reasons the owner cannot settle or release authority.

props.name: DispatchLease

text.insert: acquiring validates start gates before domain work starts. active owns dispatch and allowed mutable resources. draining forbids new work while obligations settle. blocked retains ownership until recovery or operator action makes progress safe. releasing commits final state and handoff evidence before another workflow may acquire.

props.title: Dispatch lease status values

text.insert: at. requestDispatch queues it or acquires immediately when free; beginDrain disables new work; releaseDispatch commits handoff evidence after obligations settle; recoverDispatch breaks stale or failed authority while recording cancellation and reconciliation evidence. Background-safe evidence ingestion remains outside this lease because it neither dispatches agents nor mutates checkout state.
